summary: PT Telekomunikasi Indonesia Tbk filed a Form 6-K disclosing a proposed share buyback of up to IDR 1 trillion (approx. $62M at current rates). The buyback covers common shares listed on the Indonesia Stock Exchange and ADRs on NYSE, limited to 10% of issued capital per OJK Regulation 29/2023. Execution may occur on- or off-exchange, gradually or all at once, within 12 months of the GMS approving the plan on June 8, 2026. The board assumes full responsibility; no advisor named. Watch for shareholder approval, execution pace, and impact on ADR pricing versus local shares.
